sn45.28:1.2: ariyaṃ vo bhikkhave sammāsamādhiṃ desessāmi saupanisaṃ saparikkhāraṃ
sn45.28:1.4: katamo ca bhikkhave ariyo sammāsamādhi saupaniso saparikkhāro.
sn45.28:1.6: yā kho bhikkhave imehi sattahaṅgehi cittassa ekaggatā saparikkhatā
sn45.28:1.7: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyo sammāsamādhi saupaniso itipi saparikkhāro itipīti.
